title: Social Sim Arena bundle response v1
description: One entrant's answers to one question bundle, uploaded as a single file. All three answer shapes travel in one payload because a bundle mixes all three round types: a response that could only carry scalars would force a participant into as many uploads as there are shapes, and a scoring board assembled from three separate files cannot tell a missing answer from a lost one. An answer for a round that is not in the bundle is rejected rather than ignored, and answering only some rounds is allowed -- the unanswered ones simply score nothing.

distribution.description: Either a normal (mean + sd) or a quantile set. Identical to schema/forecast.schema.json's, because that is what this normalises into: a shape accepted here and rejected there would be an upload that receipts clean and then fails CI. A point guess is not a distribution and is refused -- CRPS on a spike is just absolute error, and a forecaster who never states an uncertainty cannot be told apart from one who is always sure.

mean.description: Centre of the predictive distribution, in the question's unit.

quantiles.description: Levels as keys ('0.05' ... '0.95'), values in the question's unit. Must include '0.5' and must not decrease as the level rises.

round_id.description: A round_id from the bundle. Each may appear at most once.

topline.description: The answer to a continuous_normal question.

profile.description: The answer to a profile_energy question: exactly the cells the question named, keyed by cell id.

ranking.description: The answer to a ranking_list question: the items in predicted order, rank 1 first. A point answer by design -- a distribution over permutations is not something anybody can write down, and the round does not ask for one.

notes.description: Free text about this answer: harness version, sampling, information access. It is published with the forecast, so it must never contain an API key, an endpoint URL, or anything else you would not put in a pull request.

batch_id.description: Must equal the bundle's batch_id. Checked so last week's answers cannot be uploaded against this week's questions by editing a filename.

entrant_id.description: Your registered entrant id, matching entrants/<entrant_id>.json. Every answer is filed under it.

notes.description: Free text applied to every answer that does not carry its own. Same rule: it is published, so no credentials.
